regions.name: explorer1
regions.rationale: Focus on high sensitivity with moderate speed by using longer seeds and lower caps, while keeping early_exit off to ensure thorough gap filling.

regions.name: explorer2
regions.rationale: Balance speed and sensitivity by using shorter seeds, higher caps, and early_exit on to reduce computation while maintaining good coverage.

regions.name: explorer3
regions.rationale: Optimize for speed with minimal seed coverage and aggressive gap handling, suitable for high-throughput scenarios with less sensitivity concerns.
